title: How to Lower Your Optimum Bill: Plan Tier, Auto Pay, Bundles and a Retention Call
description: Ways to lower an Optimum internet bill: check your price lock and Auto Pay credit, drop a tier, own your modem, bundle, and call retention. Reported figures labelled. Checked November 28, 2026.
h1: How to lower your Optimum bill
lead: Six checks that can cut an Optimum internet bill, with the figures reviewers report and where they disagree.
short_answer: Optimum announced in March 2026 a $25 fiber plan locked for five years for new customers. For existing customers, reviewers report the biggest levers are moving to a cheaper tier (by the prices Reviews.org lists, 1 Gig at $45 to 300 Mbps at $35 would save $10 a month), the $10 Auto Pay and paperless credit, owning your modem, and asking retention for a loyalty rate.

sections.h2: 1. Check your plan and price lock
sections.body_html: Optimum's March 3, 2026 announcement describes Optimum Fiber Internet starting at $25 a month, "locked in for five full years", for new customers who sign up for 300 Mbps. CableTV.com reports all Optimum internet plans offered a 5-year price lock as of August 2026, with the price rising by up to $15 a month each year after it ends. Reviews.org says both that all plans include a five-year lock and that plans do not come with a guarantee, so sources disagree. Ask Optimum whether your plan has a lock and when it ends. If you joined earlier, ask to move to a current plan. See why your Optimum bill went up.

Reviews.org lists these internet prices with a $10 Auto Pay and paperless credit: 300 Mbps $35, 500 Mbps $25, 1 Gig $45, 2 Gig $65 and 8 Gig $90 a month. By those prices, moving from 1 Gig to 300 Mbps would save $10 a month, $120 a year (Reviews.org's own text says $25 a month, which does not match its table). The $25 figure for 500 Mbps looks like a special offer, since it is below the 300 Mbps price, so ask which tiers are really available. Prices vary by area and offer, so confirm yours. Use our internet speed calculator if you are unsure what you need.

sections.h2: 3. Turn on Auto Pay and paperless
sections.body_html: The advertised prices above carry a $10 monthly Auto Pay and paperless credit, according to Reviews.org and CableTV.com. If your bill does not show it, ask. CableTV.com also lists a $10 late fee.

Reviews.org says Optimum has done away with its monthly equipment rental charge, while CableTV.com lists the router rental as free or $5 a month and a Wi-Fi extender as free or $3 a month, plus a $3.50 Network Enhancement Fee it calls mandatory. Those sources differ, so look at your own bill, and ask about any equipment line you do not recognise.

sections.h2: 5. Bundle only if it lowers the total
sections.body_html: Optimum's announcement says adding Optimum Mobile and TV can save up to $15 a month. Reviews.org reports mobile bundle prices such as 300 Mbps plus unlimited mobile for $60 and says Optimum Mobile is only available to existing Optimum customers. Add up the full cost before you bundle. Do not add TV to save a few dollars. CableTV.com reports TV prices rise after year one, by up to $45 a month in some regions.

What to say when you call"My Optimum internet bill is $[total]. I would like to keep the service, but I need a lower rate. Can you move me to a current plan with a price lock, apply the Auto Pay credit, and tell me the best price you can give an existing customer? If not, please send me to retention."

Reviews.org advises asking for customer retention and says waiting about six months after leaving can bring a win-back offer. Use the number on your Optimum bill. We did not find a retention number published by Optimum. Do not count on any particular result.

sections.h2: You may not need to switch
sections.body_html: If a lower tier and the credits get you near what new customers pay, staying is simplest. If not, see how to cancel Optimum and compare providers at your address. More: 2026 internet price increases and the promo-end reminder.

faq: How do I lower my Optimum bill?
Check your price lock, try a lower speed tier, turn on Auto Pay and paperless credits, review equipment lines, and ask for customer retention.
Does Optimum charge for the modem?
Sources differ. Reviews.org says the rental charge was dropped; CableTV.com lists router rental as free or $5 a month. Check your bill.
Does Optimum have a price lock?
Optimum announced a five-year lock for its $25 fiber plan for new customers. CableTV.com reports all internet plans had a five-year lock as of August 2026. Ask Optimum about your plan.
